title: voice-settings-redesign: the per-track gear + point-mode buttons move from the graph overlay into the track's header bar; the «Настройки дорожки» dialog becomes a two-pane form (variant B); solo-spectrum and solo-wave sublane gears get their OWN dialogs (per-lane spectrum settings with «Сброс»-to-inherit; wave colour+opacity), and those sections leave the track dialog

decisions.text: RESOLVED at the VS0.1 PAUSE (owner). The owner's «тулбар голоса» = the per-track header bar GT11.5 (tracks-panel__gtrack-header, TracksPanel.vue:149-186 — stripe, fold, hidden-graphs eye, title; no gear today). BOTH overlay buttons move there: the settings gear AND the point-mode toggle (edit_location_alt) — owner picked «Тоже перенести в шапку» over keeping point-mode on the canvas. The gtrack-view__actions overlay (GTrackView.vue:83-103) is removed entirely; no buttons remain drawn in the graph. Bonus: the header is visible even when the track is folded, so access improves (today a folded track has no gear at all).

RESOLVED at the VS0.1 PAUSE (owner): redesign = VARIANT B, two-pane, modelled on the overall-waveform dialog GT10.29 (TracksPanel.vue:722-810 — section list left, content right). Sections: «График» (display mode + beat band), «Соло-звук» (TWO independent toggles «Волна»/«Спектр» replacing the 4-way off/wave/spectrum/both toggle whose «Оба» was the comprehension killer, + placement toggle with self-explanatory labels «Отдельным графиком ниже»/«Фоном под кривыми», long hint → short caption), «Голоса» (checklist). NO style settings remain in the dialog — spectrum behind its graph's gear (VS-D3), wave colour/opacity behind its graph's gear (VS-D4). Delete-track stays in the footer; title simplified to «Настройки дорожки». Rejected: A (flat form, wave style inline — obsoleted by VS-D4 moving style out), C (accordion). UI-only change: soloMode off|wave|spectrum|both stays the persisted model, the two toggles map onto it (R5).

OWNER (req. 2): the «Свои настройки спектра для этой дорожки» toggle + GTrackSpectrumSettings accordion (TracksPanel.vue:671-687) LEAVE the track dialog. The solo-spectrum sublane's existing gear (SpectrogramView :show-settings-gear, wired at TracksPanel.vue:315-321, today opening the TRACK dialog) is repointed to a NEW per-lane spectrum-settings dialog: GTrackSpectrumSettings + «Сброс» (clear the laneSpectrum override → inherit the program level), auto-individual-on-edit semantics modelled on SG-D8. The individual-else-global machinery already exists (use-gtrack-lanes.ts:276+, resolvers TracksPanel.vue:2186-2200). Inline placement («Под кривыми») has no sublane graph hence no gear — owner confirmed that is fine (switch to sublane to tune).

RESOLVED at the VS0.1 PAUSE (owner): solo-WAVE style (colour + opacity) moves OUT of the track dialog, behind the solo-wave graph's own gear (WaveformView.vue:44 already draws one; today it opens the track dialog) — a small dedicated dialog, symmetric with the spectrum (VS-D3). Inline wave placement: like the spectrum, no gear.

The per-track header bar (GT11.5, TracksPanel.vue:149-186) has stripe/fold/eye/title and NO gear — and it is visible even when the track is folded, so moving the buttons there IMPROVES access (today a folded track has no gear at all).

Dialog anatomy (TracksPanel.vue:572-717): mode toggle + beat-band; solo 4-way + hint + placement + wave colour/opacity; spectrum-custom toggle + GTrackSpectrumSettings accordion (:671-687, toggleLaneSpectrumCustom :2200); voices checklist; delete-track footer. Two-pane precedent: the waveform dialog GT10.29 (:722-810).

Per-lane spectrum override already individual-else-global: use-gtrack-lanes.ts getLaneSpectrum/setLaneSpectrum (:276+), resolvers TracksPanel.vue:2186-2200 — VS2.1 is a re-homing of an existing editor, not new model work.
